measurement.policy: UNKNOWN_EXECUTION - coordinator MUST NOT automatically retry in-flight side effects.

state_before_launch.reason: Process was not spawned; lease/intent not executed; idempotency key reusable.

state_after_launch_before_id_persisted.reason: Process may have run side effects; run ID not recorded; automatic retry prohibited; requires coordinator reconciliation.

state_after_id_persisted_before_completi.reason: Run ID known; cannot guarantee side-effect idempotency on resumption; session continuation is turn 2, not turn 1 replay.

probe_4_cancellation.containment_limitation: Process groups isolate local OS descendants only; cannot cancel remote sidecars or independent network tasks without explicit adapter heartbeat/kill API.

probe_5_adversarial_review.reviewer_response_snippet: REJECT — the change reverses the function’s behavior without supporting context, tests, or an identified defect justifying it.
